title: SDO/HMI Quick-Look Continuum — uncolored HMI intensitygram
credit: Courtesy of NASA/SDO and the AIA, EVE, and HMI science teams.

date.note: Archive filename and embedded TAI annotation are recorded as supplied; no UTC conversion or selected-time synchronization is claimed.

asset_type: Monochrome full-disk solar continuum image against black; not an equirectangular sphere map

instrument.product: Uncolored intensitygram / quick-look continuum near the visible Fe I 6173 Å absorption line

recommended_use: Optional camera-facing, depth-tested 3D disk/sprite, with a circular mask; keep the black surround and bottom-left annotation outside the displayed disk. Use an sRGB texture color space for display. The disk is not a texture atlas for a sphere.

image_geometry.inspection_method: Visual inspection and central-axis intensity bounds; pixel values above 2 extend x=34..990, y=34..990. This is a display-mask hint, not a measured solar angular radius.
image_geometry.annotation_outside_disk: small source/time text at the bottom-left edge of the image

rights.statement: SDO states that its images and movies are not copyrighted unless explicitly noted, and encourages educational reuse with attribution. No copyright exception is shown on this source image.

appearance_limits: Fixed instrument-filtered continuum image, not a live solar image or the selected UTC.
Grayscale intensity display, not a calibrated human-eye color or brightness simulation; it is not an EUV false-color solar image.
Sunspot pattern, instrument orientation and measured pixel brightness are illustrative only and must not be interpreted as selected-date surface detail or solar power.
The asset does not determine the modeled Sun direction, apparent angular size or terrain obstruction.
local_transformations: None: original official NASA JPEG bytes copied without cropping, resizing, re-encoding or color changes.
